title: I vibe coded a multiplayer roomba fighting game (with 0 game dev experience)
author: iiiiiCO
selftext:
Hello!

I built a small web game called Roomba Wars for the Cursor Vibejam.

It’s a fast, chaotic multiplayer game where you control a roomba and try to survive an arena full of other players.

The goal was simple: make something you enjoy within seconds!

What you can do:

* bump into other roombas to knock them out
* Use powerups like an M16 rifle or Lightsabers to destroy other roombas
* survive as long as possible
* embrace the chaos

The whole game is designed around instant play and fun

Tech / vibe coding setup:

* Built with Three.js (browser-based)
* Fully AI-generated (Cursor + LLMs)
* Suno for music
* Hetzner VPS

This was my first time ever making a game and also fuly vibecoding an app so would love feedback especially on:

* game feel
* clarity in the first few seconds
* what’s confusing / boring

If you want, play it here: [https://roomba-wars.com](https://roomba-wars.com)

Happy to answer any questions about the workflow or vibe coding approach.
